name: Ethen Candidate Motion System
principle: Restrained motion. Deliberate duration is a consequence instrument, not a default.

deliberateRestriction.rule: deliberate (320ms) is restricted to consequence surfaces: approval, execution, receipt and irreversible action. All other transitions use instant through page.

reducedMotion.strategy: prefers-reduced-motion collapses deliberate to instant (80ms); all other durations collapse to 0.01ms per the V2 reduced-motion contract.
